explanation: PALOMA-1 and PALOMA-2 evidence explicitly confirm investigator-assessed PFS as primary endpoint, but the PALOMA-3 evidence excerpt does not specify 'investigator-assessed,' only stating PFS was the primary endpoint met at interim analysis.
suggested_rewrite: All three trials used PFS as the primary endpoint (investigator-assessed in PALOMA-1 and PALOMA-2)—a measure of time without disease growth, distinct from survival itself.
